text:
Type: solid velvet square cushion
Use: comfort and a color accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, glam
Materials: soft cotton velvet with a subtle sheen
Colors: warm golden yellow, ochre
Shape: square, plump and soft, plain smooth surface, neat straight seams, medium size
Feel: warm, sunny, cozy, inviting
Goes with: grey, navy or green sofas, light wood, brass accents, white walls; Scandinavian, contemporary or mid-century rooms

product.name: SANELA
product.description: Cotton velvet gives depth to the colour and softness to the touch.
